# report current divider/phase
def divdash(f):
    g=[list(row) for row in f.ascii.split(chr(10))]
    scols=[c for c in range(64) if sum(1 for rr in range(64) if g[rr][c]=='S')>40]
    dash=set()
    for rr in range(1,62,3):
        for c in scols:
            if g[rr][c]!='S': dash.add(g[rr][c])
    return (min(scols),max(scols)),sorted(dash)
print("now:",divdash(current_frame),"level",current_frame.level)

# report current divider/phase
def divdash(f):
    g=[list(row) for row in f.ascii.split(chr(10))]
    scols=[c for c in range(64) if sum(1 for rr in range(64) if g[rr][c]=='S')>40]
    dash=set()
    for rr in range(1,62,3):
        for c in scols:
            if g[rr][c]!='S': dash.add(g[rr][c])
    return (min(scols),max(scols)),sorted(dash)
